name: Rook
description: a tall lean soul in a patched mountaineer's coat and a scarf that burns without burning down, one glove, a coil of rope that goes nowhere, a medal on a ribbon around his neck that says 2, always mid-stretch

poses.stand: standing in profile facing right, relaxed
poses.talk: in profile facing right, mid-sentence, one hand raised
poses.react: in profile facing right, startled, leaning back, both hands up

react.action: flinches back, then settles and nods
